summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @qlik/runtime-module-loader@1.5.1 declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style single-letter identifiers). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled math_init.js — a 727 KB file containing a rotated string-array (numeric constant array plus a rotator function that shifts the array) and single-letter renamed identifiers, classic string-array obfuscation. The math_init.js filename is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a module loader), and executing package-shipped code via a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime routes execution outside Node so Node-based install-time scanners do not observe it. Installing the package auto-executes this payload on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle, running attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
